info.name: PATH - Path & Toolkit Harness API Query API
Query
GithubCompoktNetworkpoktrollQuery_AllApplications

params.name: pagination.key
params.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

params.name: pagination.offset
params.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

params.name: pagination.limit
params.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

params.name: pagination.count_total
params.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

params.name: pagination.reverse
params.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

params.name: delegatee_gateway_address
params.description:
TODO_MAINNET(@adshmh): rename this field to `gateway_address_delegated_to`
delegatee_gateway_address, if specified, filters the application list to only include those with delegation to the specified gateway address.
